findings.symptom: The recognition helix was viewed approximately end-on but from the opposite side of the published panel.
findings.correction: Compare asymmetric protein and DNA landmarks because an end-on helix orientation still permits two opposite viewing directions.

findings.symptom: Alternate DNA atoms were drawn as lines but the smooth backbone traces in the panel were absent.
findings.correction: Create shared-plus-conformer DNA objects and show separately colored ribbons over the atomic line model.

findings.symptom: A camera corrected manually in the GUI was absent from command history.
findings.correction: Read the live camera and record the same values through set_view before exporting replay.

findings.symptom: A replay using fetch could continue after its public source was unavailable.
findings.correction: Declare source requirements and treat unresolved sources or PyMOL command errors as replay failures.

findings.symptom: GUI and headless replay produced visually equivalent but non-identical PNG bytes.
findings.correction: Score semantic state and tolerant visual similarity independently of exact file hashes.
